name: tasknotes-windows
description: Native Windows TaskNotes client over the shared Rust core

scripts.typecheck: bun scripts/dotnet.ts build TaskNotes.Windows.Portable.slnx --configuration Release --property:RestoreLockedMode=true && PATH=node_modules/@typescript/native/bin:$PATH tsc --noEmit
scripts.format: bun scripts/dotnet.ts tool restore && bun scripts/dotnet.ts csharpier format src tests && bun scripts/xaml-format.ts
scripts.format:check: bun scripts/dotnet.ts tool restore && bun scripts/dotnet.ts csharpier check src tests && bun scripts/xaml-format.ts --check
scripts.analysis: bun run typecheck && bun scripts/quality-check.ts && bunx jscpd --config .jscpd.json --silent
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && bun run analysis && bun node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --cache .
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.coverage: bun scripts/test.ts unit --coverage && bun scripts/test.ts integration --coverage && bun scripts/test.ts winui --coverage && bun scripts/coverage-ratchet.ts
scripts.coverage:portable: bun scripts/test.ts unit --coverage && bun scripts/test.ts integration --coverage && bun scripts/coverage-ratchet.ts --portable
